rules.statement: A co-owner cannot acquire prescriptive title to a co-owned property by proving exclusive possession for ten years after changing the nature of the possession to one of adverse title to the others, if the possession is not hostile to the real owner and does not amount to a denial of the owner's title.
rules.supporting_quote: In order to acquire prescriptive title a co-owner should prove exclusive possession for ten years after changing the nature of the possession to one of adverse title to the others.
